subject: Proposal: standby coverage for late CTO arrival at product demo
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novuscloud.com>, Tim Carter <tim.carter@novuscloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-09T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: standby coverage for late CTO arrival at product demo

Hi Priya / Tim —

Thanks for the heads-up on the CTO's travel. We can absolutely run the session at the scheduled start time and support the late join, but wanted to propose a quick coverage plan so we don't lose momentum for the broader audience while the CTO finishes transit. Two pragmatic options: 

1) Start on time (no delay). Marissa will lead the first 20 minutes: business outcomes, ROI highlights, and customer success stories. Marcus will take the deeper architecture & integration section once the CTO is on. We keep the same calendar slot and weave in a 15–20 minute deep-dive when the CTO lands.

2) Shift the demo by 30 minutes to guarantee the CTO joins for the full deck. That preserves the flow but may conflict with other stakeholders.

Attachments: demo-quick-agenda.pdf (recommended flow), travel-itinerary.pdf (as shared).

Can you confirm which you prefer? If option 1, we'll update the agenda to flag the quick-start and put the CTO deep-dive as ‘live-on-join’.

Short ask: please reply with “Option 1” or “Option 2” and any timing constraints for other attendees.

Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novuscloud.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Carter <tim.carter@novuscloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-09T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: standby coverage for late CTO arrival at product demo

Rafael —

On Mon, Aug 9, 2026 at 9:18 AM Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the heads-up on the CTO's travel. We can absolutely run the session at the scheduled start time and support the late join...

Option 1 sounds good to us. The CTO's flight is delayed but he plans to join ~20–25 minutes into the call. We prefer not to push the whole meeting back because several stakeholders are on tight calendars this afternoon.

Tim will dial in from the road and join as soon as he lands; he'll jump into the deep-dive section. Please go ahead and structure the first 20 minutes for high-level value and next steps.

—Priya
Priya Shah
Program Manager, Strategic Accounts
Novus Cloud
priya.shah@novuscloud.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novuscloud.com>, Tim Carter <tim.carter@novuscloud.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T10:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: standby coverage for late CTO arrival at product demo

Thanks — I’ll take the first 20 minutes.

Plan I’m proposing:
- 0:00–0:05: quick welcome, objectives, and success criteria (me)
- 0:05–0:20: outcomes + high-level business benefits + one customer example (me)
- 0:20–0:25: handoff + quick recap (Rafael)
- 0:25+: Marcus leads architecture & integration deep-dive; CTO can join at any point and we’ll loop him into the technical Q&A.

Marcus — can you have the technical slides in slide order 6–12 ready for the deep-dive? I’ll update the agenda and send an updated calendar invite with the annotated timeline. Also adding a 5-line VP briefing note (vp-briefing-notes.docx) to the invite for Tim.

If Priya/Tim need anything else pre-demo (logs, network diagram), flag it here and I’ll attach.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novuscloud.com>, Tim Carter <tim.carter@novuscloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-09T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: demo stays at 11:00 PT — VP-led start, CTO joins on arrival

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation: we will NOT push the meeting.

Final plan (calendar updated):
- 11:00 PT start — Marissa leads outcomes + business value (0–20m)
- 11:20 PT — handoff to Marcus for architecture & integration (11:20 onwards)
- CTO (Tim) to join ~11:20–11:30 PT; we will bring him into the deep-dive and technical Q&A.

Attachments added to the invite: demo-quick-agenda.pdf, vp-briefing-notes.docx. Rafael — I’ll also paste the 2–3 talking points for the VP into the invite notes.

Priya — we’ll see you at 11:00. Rafael and I will run the first section and save any CTO-specific questions to the deep-dive unless Tim calls out otherwise.

Rafael

--
